_comment: Lines drawn by hand rather than taken from an OSM route relation, because
OSM has no usable relation for them inside the frame. Every station named
here must already exist in the data: a hand line adds track, never LEDs.
The Shinkansen is on the board for one reason - it is the line that is not
like the others - and it is drawn at WEIGHT times the normal route width to
say so. It costs nothing: Ueno, Tokyo and Shinagawa are already LEDs.
Simplification, recorded rather than hidden: the Tohoku and Tokaido
Shinkansen are two separate railways that happen to meet at Tokyo. They are
drawn here as one line with two arms, because on a board whose point is
'this one is different' the distinction between them is not worth a second
OSM has the Tohoku Shinkansen as relations 9326156 / 9349293 (Tokyo - Ueno -
Omiya and back). It has no Tokaido Shinkansen route relation in this bbox,
so the Tokyo - Shinagawa arm is hand-made from the two stations it serves.

lines.name: Shinkansen
lines.source: OSM relations 9326156 / 9349293 for the Tohoku arm; the Tokaido arm hand-made from Tokyo and Shinagawa
